comparison.objective: Arrange five artifacts on a shelf so shorter objects are not hidden behind taller ones; candidate removes tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial ordering, bimanual transfer, and handover versus precision impact tooling and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Artifacts shelved without hidden or crowded configurations; exact pose and stability thresholds are absent. Candidate requires four fractures and complete tang containment with retained inserts.
comparison.reason: The record tests arrangement planning, not mechanical finishing.
